---
title: "The Toolbox"
---

One installable package, nine tools — each a simplified version of software
used in industry, each validated against textbook results before release,
and each intended for the same workflow: **verify it by hand once, then use
it for real analysis.**

```bash
%pip install git+https://github.com/YOURUSERNAME/fluidtools@v2.1.0
```

| Tool | Import | Industry analog | Used in |
|---|---|---|---|
| Hydrostatics & stability | `fluidtools.hydrostat` | naval stability suites (GHS) | Unit 3 |
| CV momentum | `fluidtools.momentum` | anchor/thrust load calcs | Unit 5 |
| Dimensional analysis | `fluidtools.similitude` | wind-tunnel test planning | Unit 2 |
| Pipe networks & pumps | `fluidtools.pipeflow` | AFT Fathom, PIPE-FLO | Unit 8, 10 |
| Flow-profile reading | `fluidtools.profiles` | PIV / CFD post-processing | Unit 6 |
| Boundary layers & drag | `fluidtools.extflow` | drag build-up (DATCOM spirit) | Unit 7 |
| DP flow meters | `fluidtools.flowmeter` | ISO-5167 sizing tools | Unit 4, 8 |
| Open channels | `fluidtools.channel` | HEC-RAS | Unit 9 |
| Turbomachinery | `fluidtools.turbo` | vendor selection software | Unit 10 |

Every tool works identically here in the browser and in your Colab
notebooks. A taste — a barge stability check, a pipe network, and a
hydraulic jump, in nine lines:

```{pyodide}
#| include: false
#| autorun: true
def _load_fluidtools():
    # 1) WASM virtual filesystem (quarto-live copies pyodide resources here)
    try:
        return open("fluidtools_bundle.py").read()
    except Exception:
        pass
    # 2) fetch from the site, trying both relative roots
    from pyodide.http import open_url
    last = None
    for _p in ("fluidtools_bundle.py", "../fluidtools_bundle.py"):
        try:
            _t = open_url(_p).read()
            if _t.lstrip().startswith("<"):      # got an HTML 404 page, not python
                raise RuntimeError("HTTP fetch returned HTML for " + _p)
            return _t
        except Exception as _e:
            last = _e
    raise RuntimeError("fluidtools bundle unreachable: %r" % (last,))
try:
    exec(_load_fluidtools(), globals())
except Exception as _e:
    try:
        import js
        js.console.error("fluidtools setup FAILED: " + repr(_e))
    except Exception:
        pass
    raise
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
```
